description:
Load a dataset into the caller's own Postgres database, as POST /v1/datasets/{id}/load does.
    Signed-in callers only. Plan first: with `apply` false (the default) it says which tables would be
    loaded, parents first, with their rows, and checks the host, writing nothing. Show the person the
    plan; call again with `apply=True` only once they agree. The load runs in one transaction and reads
    every table's rows and keys back.

    Args:
        dataset_id: from generate_dataset.
        url:        postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=require. Used for this call alone, never
                    stored or returned. A private or unencrypted host is refused.
        schema:     the Postgres schema the tables go in.
        apply:      false: the plan; true: load it.
        replace:    replace this dataset's tables where they already exist (only those tables).
name: load_dataset
title: Load a dataset into Postgres
